job.title: Insurance Technology - VP Level
job.description:
Salary: $115,000–$140,000 base + commission
Location: New York, NY | Hybrid - 4 days in office, 1 day remote
  
You’re already billing. Now it’s time to build something bigger.
  
We’re looking for a proven recruitment leader to take ownership of a high-performing Insurance Technology business within an established global financial services recruitment firm. This is not a step away from recruitment and into pure management. It’s a player-coach leadership opportunity for someone who wants to keep winning commercially while building a team, growing strategic accounts and increasing their earning potential.
  
The business is already significantly ahead of annual target, with multiple record months achieved in 2026 and established enterprise relationships creating substantial additional opportunity.
  
The Vice President, Insurance Technology will … lead from the front, combining personal production, strategic client development and team leadership to accelerate growth across the New York market.
  
Role Highlights
– Lead and develop a high-performing team of approximately 6 recruitment consultants
– Continue to personally bill while creating new revenue through senior-level relationships
– Own and expand strategic enterprise accounts across Insurance Technology
– Work alongside dedicated enterprise sales and key account teams to unlock cross-selling opportunities
– Help shape future team growth, desk strategy and the wider leadership structure
  
You Will Need
– Senior recruitment leadership experience at VP, Director, Senior Manager or equivalent level
– A proven personal billing record and genuine commercial drive
– Insurance Technology recruitment experience strongly preferred
– Experience leading teams or pods of approximately 4–8 consultants
– The confidence to win enterprise relationships, develop markets and generate demand rather than wait for vacancies
  
Why You’ll Love It
– $115,000–$140,000 base salary, with flexibility for exceptional candidates
– 25% commission up to threshold and 35% at higher billing levels, plus leadership/team override opportunities
– Join a business with multiple $1m–$2m billers and four consultants who billed $300k+ in Q2 alone
– Clear progression beyond VP level, with genuine scope to build teams and shape the business
– Healthcare, PTO, incentive trips, lunch clubs and best-in-class learning and development
– Relocation support available for experienced recruiters, including visa sponsorship and setup assistance
  
This is for someone who doesn’t want to manage from the sidelines. You’ll have the platform, accounts and infrastructure to perform, and the freedom to build on them.
  
If you’re a strong biller, a credible leader and ambitious enough to want more than a title, this is a conversation worth having.

job.title: Global Head of Energy Transisition
job.description:
Global Head | Power, Utilities & Infrastructure | New York Build and lead a global recruitment platform across one of the most important growth markets in the world.

We're partnering with an established international recruitment and executive search business to appoint a Global Head of Power, Utilities & Infrastructure.

This is a rare opportunity to take genuine ownership of a strategically important market, building a global practice across North America, EMEA and APAC while benefiting from the infrastructure, brand and investment of an established international business.

The Business
Our client is a specialist international recruitment and search business with a strong reputation across the sustainability, energy transition, infrastructure and environmental markets.
Operating internationally, the business works with corporates, investors, developers and professional services organisations addressing some of the biggest challenges associated with the global energy transition.
With an established platform, strong leadership team and ambitious growth plans, the business is now looking to make a significant investment in its Power, Utilities & Infrastructure capability.

The Opportunity
Ideally based in New York, you'll take responsibility for developing and executing the global strategy across Power, Utilities & Infrastructure.
This is not simply a management role.
You'll be expected to combine market leadership, commercial development, strategic hiring and team building, creating a platform capable of becoming a significant contributor to the wider business.
There is already a strong brand, infrastructure and international network to leverage, but you'll have genuine autonomy over how the practice develops.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Building and executing the global strategy across Power, Utilities & Infrastructure
  • Establishing and significantly scaling the business's presence across the US market
  • Developing senior client relationships across utilities, developers, investors, infrastructure businesses and the wider energy ecosystem
  • Originating high-value retained search and recruitment mandates
  • Identifying new markets, sectors and geographic opportunities
  • Hiring, developing and leading a high-performing international team
  • Working closely with the executive leadership team on wider growth strategy
  • Building a scalable, profitable global P&L
Why This Role?
This is an opportunity to build something meaningful without having to start from zero.

You'll have:
  • An established international brand and infrastructure behind you
  • Significant autonomy over strategy, hiring and market development
  • Direct access to senior executive leadership
  • The opportunity to build across the US and internationally
  • A highly relevant existing client network across sustainability and the energy transition
  • Genuine long-term equity participation
  • The opportunity to create and ultimately lead a significant global business unit
Who We're Looking For
We're interested in established recruitment and executive search leaders with a strong track record across markets such as:
  • Power
  • Utilities
  • Infrastructure
  • Energy
  • Renewables
  • Energy Transition
  • Engineering
You could currently be operating as a:
  • Managing Director
  • Practice Leader
  • Divisional Director
  • Executive Search Partner
  • Senior Recruitment Director
The successful individual is likely to combine strong personal commercial capability with a proven ability to build and lead teams.
An established senior-level network across the US Power, Utilities or Infrastructure market would be particularly attractive.
Package
  • Base salary circa $220,000-$250,000
  • Bonus potential of up to 100% of base salary
  • Equity participation 
  • Significant autonomy and global responsibility
  • New York preferred, although there may be flexibility for an exceptional individual
If you're an established leader within the Power, Utilities or Infrastructure recruitment market and want the opportunity to build a genuinely global platform, we'd love to arrange a confidential conversation.
